headline: [Weekly Supply-Demand Report] Samsung, SK Hynix Buy Back Treasury Shares Totaling 38 Trillion Won…KOSPI Up 2.7%
summary: Samsung and SK Hynix treasury share buybacks totaling 38 trillion won drove a week of large buying in Korea's stock market. The KOSPI rose 2.7% over the week.
why: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are South Korea's largest semiconductor makers, and the KOSPI is the country's main benchmark index. Their share buybacks can support both their own shares and the wider market.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Weekly gain was reported as the market maintained its upward trend in the fourth week of September.
